api.prepare: prepare(root: &Path, identity: &SpoolIdentity, tool: &ManagedProbe, cancel: &AtomicBool, deadline: Instant) -> Result<VerifiedCandidate, Fault>. Internally recompute exact owned job directory and construct SequentialSource; caller cannot supply a mutable prefix, Unit, path list, command, filename or pre-approved success boolean. Caller must drop the writer first. The deadline is never extended and is capped at24hours from entry; stage limits below are also enforced.
api.heldInput: Native-private HeldInput has no public constructor/Clone/deserialization. Finalizer creates only its new owned fixed derived files or completed candidate, syncs, closes its writer, opens deny-write/delete GuardedFile and hashes it. Accessors for packet_probe: path()->&Path; kind()->OwnedKind; len()->u64; sha256()->[u8;32]; check(&AtomicBool,Instant)->Result<(),Fault>; rehash(&AtomicBool,Instant)->Result<(),Fault>. OwnedKind is DerivedVideo, DerivedAudio or Candidate; no generic external path admission. Checks retain exact held file/ancestor identity and length; rehash is explicit once per completed process stage, not each50ms poll.
api.outputSlot: Native-private OutputSlot is constructed internally for exactly job_dir/merge-<freshUUID>.mp4. Other fixed files live in a fresh job_dir/youtube-finalize-<UUID>/ directory. Accessors: path()->&Path; begin(&AtomicBool,Instant)->Result<(),Fault> (once, absent file required); check(&AtomicBool,Instant)->Result<(),Fault> (current source-independent output bounds/reserve/ancestor identity); finish(self,&AtomicBool,Instant)->Result<HeldInput,Fault> only after child exit0/physicalEOF. The tool uses -n. Once the output appears, hold a read-attributes-only, deny-delete/share-read-write handle to its exact identity while the owned child writes; compare path identity, reject reparse/nonregular/multilink/replacement and disappearance. After child completion replace this with read-only deny-write/delete holding and hash. No pre-created file passed to overwrite flags.
api.candidate: VerifiedCandidate is non-Clone, private-constructor, retaining full source identity/flags, held source context, candidate and directories, exact length/hash, common origin, codec and per-track comparison evidence. with_verified_path(cancel,deadline,callback) lends only the exact path plus expected hash/length under guards before/after callback; it is a read-only verification seam, not permission to rename around a deny-delete handle. Publication consumes this capability in a separate root-owned exact-hash/identity handoff. Existing verify_publish_from alone lacks expected-hash binding; no bare returned path or success boolean may bypass the handoff. Candidate proof does not certify first-RAP/in-band production admission.

algorithm: Prepare one SequentialSource from exact internal proof/journal. Both Complete nonempty indexes required. Corrupt/Cancelled or incomplete structural tail fails; Interrupted/torn/uncommitted flags remain attached to all evidence and are not promoted to full recording success. One full retained interval, no trimming/prefix repair/packet exclusion in this first version.

Create fresh owned attempt directory and fixed video.webm/audio.mp4/video.packets/audio.packets files with create_new, existing Guards and sync. Preflight total native units/items and same-track coverage using bounded counters; max100000units and20M packets per track. Preserve original init and media using TrackBuilder. Source passes are fixed in number and linear, never select_unit/rescan per unit. Every visit must finish Complete with its prepared digest and final guards.

For every original native unit, use existing bounded source codec probe and packet probe in sequential visits. Exact configuration/metadata/timebase agreement across units. Stream every validated PacketFact into that track's disk packet_tape::Writer and a constant-space TrackFold; construct aggregate ProbeFacts only after every unit process and the whole source visit succeed. Sync tapes; retain private tape Summary and guarded file identity. No collected packet vector. Per-unit tool startup cost is linear and must be measured, not represented as constant time.

Require native interval continuity plus packet evidence for full two-track coverage. AAC packet DTS/PTS end-to-next-start must be exact; video must have positive known durations, ordered native complete units and no unexplained demux/native mapping. AAC first/start covers video first and AAC last/end covers video last using exact parsed native clocks and reported timebases; only independently proved boundary quantization is allowed, no blanket epsilon or intended offset. Unsupported uncertainty fails explicitly. Common origin is the exact minimum admitted first PTS across both tracks, never independent zeroing.

Reindex derived tracks under their expected native clocks and retained length/hash. Whole derived codec and packet probes must match source metadata and disk tape exactly with origin0, same source timebases, full packet count/order/hash/size/key/side and timestamps. This checks the TrackBuilder result rather than trusting streamcopy. Read one tape record at a time; a tape read error never means EOF.

Create unique candidate with pinned FFmpeg fixed two-input map, -c copy, -n, forced local formats and one proven common origin. No -shortest/genpts/trim/repair, extra tracks, reencode or source rewrite. Complete child/physicalEOF/tool/source/output guards and candidate sync+hash holding precede verification.

Parse whole candidate full codec projection (no select_streams) and require exactly supported video0+audio1. For each candidate packet probe, read one expected disk-tape fact and feed PairComparison; reject extra/missing/reordered/changed payload/flags/side. After full physical tape EOF and process success, every max PTS/DTS/duration error must be <= sourceTick+outputTick by checked rational arithmetic. Report exact observed errors. Fully decode both required streams with -xerror. Rehash held candidate/source attempt inputs and recheck all guards before constructing VerifiedCandidate.

Candidate max and observed output checked while child writes and again after completion; polling is not a pre-write physical quota.
limits.disk: Use existing1GiB protected reserve. Before attempt and each stage, checked-add conservative still-to-write bounds for both derived lengths, candidate (raw committed sum plus bounded packet/container overhead, capped128GiB), both tapes and manifest headroom. Check actual free bytes periodically during native writes and child output polling. A budget/reserve failure cancels owned work and preserves sources/partial outputs; never automatic cleanup or unlimited retry. Explicit stage cap may reject an extreme input rather than claim a24hour recording capacity guarantee.
limits.time: Caller absolute deadline capped24hours. Each original unit packet probe <=120seconds and codec probe <=30seconds as existing. Whole derived/candidate packet probes, remux and decode use remaining overall deadline, not a fresh per-unit deadline and not fixed120seconds for an hours-long track. All process workers must join and owned process be reaped on failure/cancel. Existing documented OS-blocking-I/O/memory caveats remain; do not advertise a hard OS bound.
limits.retry: No automatic retry loop in prepare. A later explicit owned-job recovery may create a new attempt UUID and fully revalidate sources, preserving earlier failed attempts. Failure states remain fixed enums; no media bytes/URLs/account text logged.

nativeTailReview.authority: Root approved the two independently identified corrections on 2026-10-15 before this edit; only PacketClock and its tests change.
nativeTailReview.evidence: The native WebM parser already uses explicit BlockDuration for a final BlockGroup. Requiring DefaultDuration at that boundary falsely rejects a structurally proven unit end (including the actual fixed capture); it does not prove a source gap. PacketFact's closed decoder already rejects zero duration, so an unwrap-based invalid fixture must not panic before the tested assertion.
nativeTailReview.decision: For the last packet only, compare its demux duration to floor((native.end-native.last)/native tick), with strictly positive checked native difference. First/last PTS and DTS remain exact native clock comparisons. Intermediate video durations and timestamp advances retain DefaultDuration-derived floor/ceil checks. No blanket epsilon, wall-clock inference, source mutation, trimming, or codec admission relaxation. Nonzero SkipSamples and reordered PTS/DTS remain explicitly unsupported coverage cases, preserved on failure.
checks: Explicit final BlockDuration differing from DefaultDuration passes only its exact native-tick quantization; the default-tail value is rejected.
Zero-duration serialized packet is directly rejected by PacketFact decoder; no impossible typed fact is constructed.

acceptance: Existing actual two-unit300/431 fixture through this real disk-backed API, candidate same all-packet/codec/decode proof and original hashes unchanged; root owns execution.

Wrong full source identity, clock/config, interior gap, audio lead/lag not covering video, unknown duration/mapping, unsupported first-RAP/inband are not promoted. No silent trimming.
